part.name: DCIM / BMS / EPMS（监控、运维、电力监控软件）
part.desc: 软件条目：有订阅价与供应商，进目标表，不进 3D（用户 2026-09-28 决定）

exact_registry_identity.identity_note: DCIM/BMS/EPMS are three selected responsibility labels within one registered dcim software category, not three new physical or software IDs. Software is intentionally nonphysical, not a pending hardware-model omission.

primary_sources_actually_read.title: EcoStruxure IT Expert — official DCIM product overview
primary_sources_actually_read.actual_read: HTML substantive lines9–62 and FAQ153–158; page total193lines, via web open, not search-only.
supports: One vendor DCIM example centralizes visibility for power/cooling/IT assets, device/environment alarms, reports and analysis.
Some software management capabilities include device discovery/configuration, user management and remote firmware deployment.
does_not_establish: Universal DCIM scope or a complete DCIM standard definition.
Actual site discovery, sensors, points, alarm values, polling interval/latency, connection state, installation or autonomous control.
All devices support remote firmware/configuration or every DCIM deployment supports identical write actions.
primary_sources_actually_read.adopted_limit: Only generic monitoring/alarms/analysis/management role and conditional optional operations. No AI, downtime prevention, sustainability/UPS health or real-time performance claims are adopted.

primary_sources_actually_read.title: Johnson Controls — Data Center Building Controls
primary_sources_actually_read.actual_read: HTML substantive lines312–393; page total516lines. Read monitoring/control at322, system description337, access/logs363, software monitor/command/report376, distributed controller381 and sensor-data collection393.
supports: One BMS/BAS example includes environmental/connected-equipment monitoring, software commands and reporting; local controllers and sensors are separate from supervisory software.
Actual BMS offerings can include equipment control and automated response, with access-control/event-log capabilities.
does_not_establish: That a generic DCIM screen directly closes a plant loop or bypasses local controllers/protection.
Specific setpoints, controller algorithms, failover/redundancy, PUE/WUE values, safety/compliance, site topology or installed controllers/sensors.
primary_sources_actually_read.adopted_limit: Represent supervisory environmental/equipment role; if local control is referenced, use a separate conditional functional boundary, no new physical ID or unmodeled actuator geometry. Automation may exist in particular designs, but TA28 does not certify it.

primary_sources_actually_read.title: Power Monitoring Expert 2024 — Default User Access Level Privileges
primary_sources_actually_read.actual_read: Full substantive HTML table lines27–115, page total122; original official URL redirects to canonical. Original/reference open returned actual text twice. One direct canonical re-open returned tool-access error, retained as failed read attempt, then reference re-open succeeded.
primary_sources_actually_read.document_date: Last updated2024-01-09; version-specific example, not all EPMS policy.
supports: This power-monitoring software distinguishes application viewing, alarm acknowledgment, dashboard/trend/report work and configuration through permissions.
Alarm acknowledgment and view permissions differ; user-group application scope is an additional condition.
Device connection/configuration, UPS/generator configuration, Modbus gateway and notifications are separate gated functions in this example.
does_not_establish: That acknowledging an alarm fixes its physical cause, or that reading telemetry authorizes a device write.
A universal five-role system, an installed EPMS, all electric metrics/quality analysis, automatic breaker operation, point mapping or local control readiness.
primary_sources_actually_read.adopted_limit: Use electricity-focused monitoring/alarms/trends/reports as a functional lane; optional operations require product capability, integration and software permission. Do not label software credentials as six site rights.

suggested_1536_layout.title: 控制与软件：监测、告警与可选授权操作
suggested_1536_layout.subtitle: 一个dcim软件类别的职责示例；信息关系非现场接线，示意界面非实测

context_area.content: 同源TA18园区母图等比完整呈现；标题“被监测对象上下文（未证明接入）”。不添加传感器、线缆、PLC或硬件屏幕。

software_area.content: 纯二维软件信息区：DCIM/BMS/EPMS三平行职责条，统一标注part:dcim；职责有交叉，非三个必须串联或互斥产品。

nodes: 设备/系统提供信息（功能来源，不表示已经接入）
接口采集与点位映射（功能节点，具体协议/点表未知）
监测/历史趋势/告警与报告（示意小屏，无数值）
人员研判、确认与处置记录（不等于物理故障已清除）
primary_information_flow.arrows: 工程蓝实线箭头表示信息前向流，不表示供电、管线或实物电缆；圆点只做真实图片对象定位，功能线用明确端点。

optional_operations_inset.content: 灰虚线独立分支：按产品能力+接口配置+软件权限发起操作请求→既有设备/现场控制层；状态/结果可返回。注明“可选，非本园区已部署自动闭环”。不把命令箭头直接连为全部机电设备的自动闭环。

suggested_1536_layout.illustrative_screen: 只画字段名、空白/未接入占位、告警/趋势/报告视图类别；可用无刻度无数值的界面框，显著标“界面示意”。不画伪时间戳、百分比、功率、温度、PUE、告警计数或正常绿色状态。
suggested_1536_layout.footer: 软件访问权限与站点权利不同；所有对象/点表/采样时效/连接/自动策略与现场部署未知。

five_material_semantic_risks.risk: 把一个dcim软件登记拆成三个实体、机房中的屏幕/控制箱，或写“尚未建模”暗示未来要造软件硬件。
five_material_semantic_risks.required_boundary: 明确kind=software/无物理模型；三职责条不增加BOM/物理ID；示意屏是解释图元。

five_material_semantic_risks.risk: 把监测→告警→确认→设备控制画成无条件自动闭环；把确认告警等同修复。
five_material_semantic_risks.required_boundary: 监测/告警/人员处置是主流；可选授权操作独立虚线区，本地控制/保护能力按具体系统另核。BMS确可自动控制，但本图不证明部署。

five_material_semantic_risks.risk: 示意dashboard数值/趋势曲线/绿色正常/实时时钟暗示已采集或实时实测。
five_material_semantic_risks.required_boundary: 图面明确界面示意、未证明接入；仅字段与视图占位，无实测数字/刻度/告警计数/状态结论；厂商real-time宣传不作为本图时效保证。

five_material_semantic_risks.risk: 把职责边界画成绝对互斥或三软件硬串联；从园区母图拉32条实物线暗示现场点表/协议/完整拓扑。
five_material_semantic_risks.required_boundary: 三平行角色有交集，采集/映射只是功能节点；上下文图与信息逻辑分区，不给未证协议、传感器点位、网关/PLC实体或跨全部设备连接。

five_material_semantic_risks.risk: 软件访问权限、设备存在/电量统计或合规报告被当作土地/水权/并网/供气/网络接入/许可的成立证据。
five_material_semantic_risks.required_boundary: 六站点权利保持独立非物理site节点；软件账号权限只控制软件操作，不代表工程许可或资源权利。

six_site_rights.name: 电力配额与并网（排队年限、并网协议）
天然气管道接入（容量、供气合同）
网络接入（暗光纤、运营商、IXP）
许可（区划、环评、排放、建设）
